messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: Error while loading "RJDBC" package
parts:
I am getting error while loading RJDBC package.

my Code:

library("plyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("reshape")
library("scales")
require("scales")
library("RJDBC")

Error in rapache log:

==> error_log <==
[Fri Jul 06 15:03:55 2012] [error] [client 127.0.0.1] rApache Notice!

Attaching package: 'reshape'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:plyr':

    rename, round_any

Loading required package: DBI
Loading required package: rJava
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rJava', details:
  call: dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...)
  error: unable to load shared object '/usr/local/lib64/R/library/rJava/libs/rJava.so':
  libjvm.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
Error: package 'rJava' could not be loaded
Traceback:
3: stop(gettextf("package %s could not be loaded", sQuote(pkg)),
       call. = FALSE, domain = NA)
2: .getRequiredPackages2(pkgInfo, quietly = quietly)
1: library("RJDBC")

I can find libjvm.so at many locations.

$ find / -name libjvm.so -print
/usr/lib/jvm/java-1.6.0-openjdk-1.6.0.0.x86_64/jre/lib/amd64/server/libjvm.so
/usr/lib/jvm/java-1.5.0-gcj-1.5.0.0/jre/lib/x86_64/server/libjvm.so
/usr/lib/jvm/java-1.5.0-gcj-1.5.0.0/jre/lib/x86_64/client/libjvm.so
/usr/lib64/gcj-4.4.4/libjvm.so

I tried to add the path to /etc/ld.so.conf

[perf@localhost etc]$ cat /etc/ld.so.conf
include ld.so.conf.d/*.conf
include /usr/local/lib64/R/lib
include /usr/lib/jvm/java-1.6.0-openjdk-1.6.0.0.x86_64/jre/lib/amd64/server/
[perf@localhost etc]$


And also to /etc/ld.so.conf.d/R-x86_64.conf. Could you please help me debug?

[perf@localhost ld.so.conf.d]$ cat /etc/ld.so.conf.d/R-x86_64.conf
/usr/lib64/R/lib
/usr/lib/jvm/java-1.6.0-openjdk-1.6.0.0.x86_64/jre/lib/amd64/server/
[perf@localhost ld.so.conf.d]$

I have also enabled java support in R by executing $ R CMD javareconf.

Regards
Santosh Marigodwa

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Error while loading "RJDBC" package
parts:
rApache won't see any changes to the R environment that you made with
'R CMD javareconf'. Whatever that command changed, and if it sets java
environment variables, you'll have to manually set before you start
apache.

Jeff

messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: Re: Error while loading "RJDBC" package
parts:
I think I solved this issue.

I had to execute the command ldconfig, after all the steps i explained before, and restart apache, thats it.

RJDBC package is now loaded, however I could see a notice message from RApache. This could be redherring, not sure, because no specific errors are reported by RApache apart from the notice line.

==> error_log <==
[Fri Jul 06 16:02:51 2012] [error] [client 127.0.0.1] rApache Notice!

Loading required package: DBI
Loading required package: rJava

There is a detailed post about this issue @

http://oddhypothesis.blogspot.co.uk/2012/06/making-rapache-load-rjava.html?showComment=1341586724938#c1789864956683835694

Regards
Santosh Marigowda
